{{Quote|Good girl.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Boga|<ref name="swrots">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Varactyls''', also known as '''dragonmounts''', were [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] herbivores native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], though some specimens found their way to worlds such as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="ROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> and [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Biology==
[[File:Varactyl_DK.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Boga/Legends|Boga]], a female Varactyl]]
They had beaked faces and long, powerful tails that could stretch to 10 meters. The varactyl's flexible neck supported its armor-plated skull, and both male and female dragonmounts had crests and a ridge of mid-body spines displayed during courting. While females sported blue-green plumage and skin, males were mostly dull shades of orange and brown. Most important were the varactyl's five-toed feet. Not only could a varactyl run very fast, but their feet were adapted with tiny hairlike structures that allowed them to climb the rocky walls of Utapau's sinkholes. This marked the varactyl as an excellent mount for the native Utapauns.

A varactyl's vocalizations were short, loud hooting calls.<ref name="ROTS">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars:'' Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]</ref> They were similar in nature to those of a [[suubatar]].<ref name="swrots" />

Varactyls were very intelligent creatures who long remembered previous riders. The varactyl's reaction to a rider depended on how that rider had treated it previously: it would be loyal and affectionate to a good rider, but hostile and dangerous to an abusive one.

Varactyl subspecies included the [[dwarf varactyl]], varactyl venomblade, varactyl preystalker and [[deathspine varactyl]].<ref name="ROTW" /> A breed called the iridescent varactyl was available to be won by patrons of the [[Star Cluster Casino]] or [[Club Vertica Casino]].<ref name="Star Cluster Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Star Cluster Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Club Vertica Casino">{{TORcite|type=location|Club Vertica Casino|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> It could have been related to the [[Nos monster/Legends|nos monster]] on Utapau.

==History==
[[File:BogaROTS-SWE.png|thumb|250px|[[Boga/Legends|Boga]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]]]
Long ago, the stunted [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] learned to tame wild varactyl and still served as wranglers for the dragonmounts, acting as keepers of both varactyl and their flying [[Dactillion/Legends|dactillion]] cousins. Varactyl were known to be loyal and obedient steeds. Riding a varactyl was reportedly similar to riding the speedy [[suubatar]]s of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Both creatures were fitted with high-backed [[Saddle/Legends|saddles]] for their riders.

In order to track down [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used a particularly swift and loyal varactyl named [[Boga/Legends|Boga]]. In record time, Boga reached the tenth level of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], and engaged General Grievous in his [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike|wheel bike]] in a furious chase through the city.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] carried out [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by ordering an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE's]] gunner to fire upon Boga and Obi-Wan; however, the AT-TE's cannon blast hit a wall near them, and the two plunged to the grotto below.<ref name="ROTS />

Many years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], someone had brought a live varactyl egg to Kashyyyk. When the egg was subsequently lost, it hatched, and soon dozens of varactyl populated a section of jungle on the Wookiee homeworld. As varactyls were not known to be able to reproduce asexually, how this happened is unknown.

A large number of varactyls once attacked the Wookiees of the [[Kerritamba Village]]. After they had finally fended off the attacks at the [[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Great Tree]], the Wookiees drove the varactyls out of the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]].<ref name="ROTW" />
